posts.name: X-metal
posts.cooked:
You know how all other fandoms have nicknames they call themselves like the bronies and the potter heads and the whovians right? Do we sentinels fans have something like that? Because if we don't I would like to suggest a couple. Maybe you guys could come up with some better ones.

 

  • The most obvious of course is Sentinels
  • or sentinels of the multiverse which would get really confusing.
  • Or Greater than Gamers or GtGamers for fans of greater than games as a whole.
  • or my personal favorite: Radio Landians because that's what Christopher and Adam call us on they're podcast.

 

What do you guys think? Got any ideas of your own? Or is one already in place and I'm just late to the party.

posts.name: Chaosmancer
posts.cooked:
I've never thought much about it, Sentinels seems pretty inclusive for now, but I've always liked the Citizens at Gencon.

 

 

I'm now fascinated by the desire to know what the in-universe fans of the public superhero teams call themselves. We know there is a at least one crazy stalker fan (Radioactivist) so it is clearly possible to have sane fans.

 

You think they ever get a moment in sentinel comics like we've had in Spider-MAn or Justice League, where the heroes are beat down and almost dead and the every day citizens come to their rescue? Those are always cool moments for me, seeing the community at large throw their weight behind their hero. Though, in a realistic sense, most of them would be pretty horribly killed or beaten by a majority of the villains.
